decisive_spans.text: The serum CA 19-9 level was within the normal range

response.rationale: D2 is supported by the presence of a cystic lesion in the pancreatic head and a normal CA 19-9 level, which is characteristic of serous cystadenoma. D1 is also supported by the cystic mass in the pancreatic head, but the normal CA 19-9 level makes it less likely than D2. D3 is contradicted by the normal CA 19-9 level. D4 is a finding, not a diagnosis for the pancreatic mass.
